threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can always spot a newbie by how they still wait for the Tube during strike days, while the locals calmly grab a bike or walk it.
Caught a night bus from Canada Water the other week; an old chap tried to sell me an ancient map of London. Said it was 'the real treasure' but forgot where he got it from.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a toddler waving at a pigeon outside my window, while two artists painted a mural on the building next door. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a bustling market on a Tuesday morning selling everything from vegan cheeses to vintage vinyl. It’s a hidden gem for locals.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re a local when they still call it 'Civic Center' and not 'Twitter headquarters' during the BART chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that had a band onboard, playing to the aisle. If that’s not San Francisco, I don’t know what is. Everyone was vibing.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just the hipster hub. They miss the real heart in its quiet squares where locals gossip over coffee.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them lingering at the metro machine, puzzled by the ticket options, while locals zip by with their preloaded T-cards.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep looking for the 'last train' signs, not realizing they don't exist after 12am. Good luck finding a night bus in the rain!
Last night, the 227 rolled in 20 minutes late, and some bloke started singing 'Wonderwall' at the back. Oddly enough, everyone joined in. Nothing unites the late-night crowd like dodgy karaoke.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a group of kids making a makeshift skatepark in an empty lot, music blasting from a tiny speaker. Pure Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: I saw a guy at Görlitzer Park feeding pigeons with leftover Döner. They were practically lining up for it! Only in Berlin do even the pigeons get gourmet treatment.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local if they know the secret to avoid the BART delays—like skipping Civic Center when the train’s been acting up. It’s practically a survival skill.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 with a guy juggling flaming torches, while a saxophonist played smooth jazz. Only in the Tenderloin, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the best tapas are found in fancy spots; they miss the tiny bars where locals swap stories over a plate of olives.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look for the 'més' in the metro maps, confused by how close everything really is.
